title.narrative: GMS Kunming-Haiphong Transport Corridor - Noi Bai-Lao Cai Highway Project

description.narrative: The Project is designed to provide (i) a 244-kilometer grade-separated and access-controlled highway, including 10 interchanges with toll booths and five service areas, starting at Noi Bai in a suburb of Hanoi and ending at Lao Cai, on the border with the People's Republic of China (PRC) in northwest Viet Nam; (ii) electric, communications, and tolling systems and associated facilities, and the Vietnam Expressway Corporation's (VEC's) highway operation and maintenance (O&M) equipment and vehicles; and (iii) capacity building for VEC on management of project implementation, corporate financing management, O&M of highways, and safeguard planning and implementation.

description.narrative: International and local traffic use an efficient, safe, and reliable express route from Noi Bai to Lao Cai on the border with PRC

Annual average daily traffic volume increased
Baseline (2008): 20,000-25,000 for Noi Bai-Viet Tri section; 6,000-12,000 for Viet Tri-Yen Bai section; and 3,500 for the Yen Bai-Lao Cai section Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. The VEC's traffic counts show that the average number of vehicles per day in 2018 was 14,921 on the Noi Bai-Viet Tri section, 9,105 on Viet Tri - Yen Bai section, and 4,977 on Yen Bai - Lao Cai section. Data Source: Economic and Financial Report Base year: 2007 Baseline value: N

Average travel time between Noi Bai and Lao Cai reduced
Baseline (2008): 8 hours for passenger cars, 9 hours for buses, and 12 hours for trucks Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. The vehicle travel time from Noi Bai to Lao Cai reduced to 3 hours 30 minutes for car, 4 hours 30 minutes for bus, and 5 hours for trucks. Data Source: Interview with drivers Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N

Expansion of the expressway network under VEC-managed projects.
Baseline (2009): 349 km expressway under construction Progress/Status: Achieved. The total length of the expressways in the country reached 552 km in 2018. Data Source: Business plan and financial statement of VEC Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N

International free-trade zone and industrial parks along the project highway developed
Baseline (2008): Lao Cai free-trade zone under construction Progress/Status: Achieved. In the period of 2011-2017, the industrial parks increased by 14% in Noi Bai, 130% in Vinh Phuc, 279% in Phu Tho, 23% in Yen Bai, and 27% in Lao Cai. Data Source: Economic and industrial statistics from Ministry of Planning and Investment Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N

Motality index (Number of fatalities per billion traffic volume-kilometers) reduced by 60%
Baseline (2008): 18 fatalities for Noi Bai-Viet Tri section; 6 fatalities for Viet Tri-Yen Bai section; and 6 fatalities for the Yen Bai-Lao Cai section Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. The fatality rate reduced from 16.3 fatalities per billion vehicle-km in 2015 to 0.8 in 2018. However, the traffic accidents on the project highway were still remarkable, about 184 times in 2014-2018, with 46 people killed. Data Source: Economic and Financial Report Base year: 2008 Baseline value: N

No increase of HIV/AIDS cases in the project area
Baseline (2009): 3,631 cases in Vinh Phuc, 8,195 cases in Phu Tho, 2,646 cases in Yen Bai, and 549 cases in Lao Cai Progress/Status: Not achieved. The percentage of the HIV infected population grew in all project provinces. In Vinh Phuc, the infected people grew by 23%. Phu Tho and Lao Cai moderately grew. Data Source: Monitoring by the Ministry of Health Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N

Number of long-distance buses on the highway in a day increased by 50%
Baseline (2009): 49 buses from Ha Noi, to Yen Bai, 31 buses from Ha Noi to Lao Cai 0 buses from Ha Noi to Kunming Achievement: Y Progress/Status: Achieved. According to the VEC's traffic counts, there were more than 500 large buses a day on the project highway in 2018, most of them were for public transportation. Local bus service was available in all project districts. Data Source: Timetables of bus companies Base year: 2009 Baseline value: N
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: The 244 km of Noi Bai-Lao Cai Highway, with 10 grade-separated interchanges and five service areas, is constructed to a high standard and operational Indicator: Transportation cost reduced by 20% for trips along the highway in 2014 Achievement: 30.8 Progress/Status: Achieved. The unit vehicle operation cost (VOC) reduced by average 30.8% in comparing with the “without-project” case. Data Source: Monthly and quarterly progress reports

Output: The 244 km of Noi Bai-Lao Cai Highway, with 10 grade-separated interchanges and five service areas, is constructed to a high standard and operational Indicator: Travel distance from Noi Bai to Lao Cai reduced from 298 km to 255 km in 2014 Achievement: 245.2 Progress/Status: Achieved. 100% of the civil works have been completed.
